evidence.title: Watermelon UI: Free React Components, Blocks & Dashboards
UI Blocks - Pre-built Sections | Watermelon UI

name: Watermelon UI
summary: Open-source React UI platform: components, animated pieces, pre-built blocks, dashboards and templates for Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
description: Watermelon UI collects production-style React building blocks: copy-paste blocks (hero, navbar, pricing, footer, cta, stats, faq …), animated components, dashboards and full templates. It is free and open-source (MIT), with 403 documented pages served through a shadcn registry (778 items) installed with the shadcn CLI, plus a public catalog API, an OpenAPI contract, llms.txt and a hosted MCP server for AI agents.
contains: 778 shadcn registry items; install with the shadcn CLI
403 documented pages: components, blocks, dashboards, templates
block categories: hero, navbar, footer, pricing, cta, stats, team, bento, 404, file upload, newsletter, widget
public catalog API with OpenAPI contract and llms.txt for agents
hosted MCP server at mcp.watermelon.sh for ChatGPT/Claude clients
